description: This is the main activity Java source file for an Android Wear OS application that manages runtime permissions for sensors and storage, communicates with a paired phone device via Google Play Services, and handles user interface updates related to permissions and data requests.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android Wear app, managing permissions, connection to GoogleApiClient, messaging with phone, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds GoogleApiClient for Wearable API.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Handles click event for local sensors permission button; requests permission if not granted, otherwise displays sensor count.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Handles click event to request data from the phone device via messaging.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability and message listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects GoogleApiClient and updates permission status.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intent, particularly for remote permission prompts.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect ambient mode for permissions.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Restores UI from ambient mode.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets capability and message listeners, fetches capability info about phone node.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of API connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates the phone node ID when capability changes.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Processes result of runtime permission requests for sensors.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the phone, including permission responses and data.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the connected phone node using GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission rationale activity.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects a suitable node ID from a set of nodes based on proximity.

methods.name: launchPermissionDialogForPhone
methods.description: Requests sensor permission if not already granted.

methods.name: updatePhoneButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates the UI state of the phone permission button based on current permission states.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Logs messages to the UI text view, ensuring thread safety.
